title: HERMES Shared-Stream Recovery Phase-2 Evidence Snapshot v1
description: Immutable, versioned, provenance-bearing LIVE-evidence snapshot a future Phase-2 shadow adapter would hand to the UNCHANGED Phase-1 pure core (utils/hermes_shared_stream_recovery_v1.decide). INERT / DESIGN-ONLY. Sufficient to reproduce the shadow decision OFFLINE. Missing evidence is represented as UNAVAILABLE, NEVER defaulted to a favourable value. WO-HELM-HERMES-SHARED-STREAM-RECOVERY-PHASE2-SHADOW-ADAPTER-AND-EVIDENCE-CONTRACT-DESIGN-0001.

snapshot_id.description: Deterministic sha256[:16] over the canonical snapshot. No randomness, no wall-clock.

captured_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the evidence was captured.

evaluated_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant injected into decide() (usually == captured_at_utc).

source_sha.description: Canonical git sha of the evidence-producing code — offline reproduction anchor.

runtime_identity.description: Sanitised host/pid/env. MUST NOT contain secrets, tokens, or account ids.

connection_generation.description: Monotonic connection generation for callback dedup/bounding scoping.

socket_state.description: Control-plane socket state. CONNECTED != healthy flow (connect() only proves auth reachability).

heartbeat_available.description: Whether AdapterHealth.last_tick_at heartbeat truth is available (bumped by HEARTBEAT and PRICE).

heartbeat_age_s.description: now - last_tick_at. null when heartbeat truth is unavailable -> fail closed, never healthy-defaulted.

shared_stream_silent.description: No line at all (incl heartbeat) past the stall horizon (asyncio.TimeoutError seam).

parser_fatal.description: Enumerated FATAL parser/task termination ONLY; ordinary malformed is recoverable/advisory, not this.

shared_progress_available.description: Any-message liveness availability, DISTINCT from per-instrument freshness. null => mirror heartbeat.

provider_maintenance_indication.description: OANDA emits no maintenance signal -> value False + provenance NOT_CURRENTLY_AVAILABLE; never inferred.

validated.description: Governed validated schedule. WTICO_USD/SPX500_USD -> false (no transport vote).

limiter_available.description: False models the limiter store being unreadable -> fail closed for non-emergency authority.

field_provenance.description: Per-field provenance. The honesty spine: availability class + directly-observed-vs-inferred.

evidence_completeness.description: INCOMPLETE => an authority-bearing field is UNAVAILABLE => shadow fails closed, decision withheld.
